section_summary: These pages continue a statistical report on Japan’s public debt and banking system. They give historical and monthly figures for the Bank of Japan, the Ministry of Finance Deposit Bureau, ordinary banks, and savings banks, explain the 1946 division of bank accounts, and end with conversions of Japanese weights and measures.

subfiles.title: Statistical report on Japanese finance and weights and measures, concluding pages
subfiles.about: Tables and notes on Japanese public debt, bank balance sheets, postwar account reorganization, and unit conversions.
subfiles.summary: The report charts national debt and the assets and liabilities of the Bank of Japan, the Ministry of Finance Deposit Bureau, ordinary banks, and savings banks. It explains how banks divided their accounts into new and old accounts in August 1946, then presents separate figures for those accounts. The final page converts selected Japanese weights and volume measures and lists caloric values for rice.
